editor.plainHttp: This address uses plain http:// to another computer on the internet: the API key is sent unencrypted. Use https:// if the server supports it.

openai.name: OpenAI
openai.note: Current models reason by default: temperature isn't sent and the output limit goes in max_completion_tokens (see Advanced). gpt-6.1-terra and gpt-6-luna can turn reasoning off.

anthropic.name: Anthropic
anthropic.note: The address is without /v1. Claude models reject a temperature, so it isn't sent.

openrouter.name: OpenRouter
openrouter.note: Model IDs look like vendor/model (versions with dots, e.g. anthropic/claude-sonnet-5.5). Some models must reason: don't send “thinking off” to them.

azure.name: Azure OpenAI
azure.note: Use your resource's address (…/openai/v1) and the key from the portal. The model is your deployment name.

deepseek.name: DeepSeek
deepseek.note: DeepSeek models think first by default. For live translation, check the thinking parameter example against the selected model's documentation. The address works without /v1.

kimi.name: Kimi (Moonshot)
kimi.note: Kimi fixes the temperature, so it isn't sent. K3 models always reason; check the model documentation before changing reasoning effort. Keys from platform.kimi.com (China) and platform.kimi.ai (international) are separate.

zhipu.name: Zhipu GLM
zhipu.note: The path is /api/paas/v4, not /v1, and there's no model list: type the model. GLM thinks by default; glm-5.3 can't turn it off, glm-5.2 can (check the model documentation before editing the task parameters).

qwen.name: Qwen (DashScope, OpenAI-compatible)
qwen.note: Keys are tied to their region: use the international address with an international key. qwen-plus and qwen-flash don't think by default; the qwen3.x models do.

volcengine.name: Volcengine Ark (Doubao)
volcengine.note: The path is /api/v3. The model is a model ID (activate it in the console first) or an inference endpoint ID (ep-…); there's no model list, so type it.

minimax.name: MiniMax
minimax.note: MiniMax-M3 can turn thinking off; MiniMax-M3.1-Flash can't. China and international keys are separate.

hunyuan.name: Tencent Hunyuan (TokenHub)
hunyuan.note: Hunyuan is served through TokenHub now; activate the model in the console first (otherwise HTTP 402). Existing Hunyuan accounts can still use https://api.hunyuan.cloud.tencent.com/v1.

ollama.name: Ollama
ollama.note: Works with Ollama on this computer or another one on your network (e.g. http://192.168.1.20:11434). Fetch the model list to check it's running.

selfhosted.name: Self-hosted (vLLM, LiteLLM, One API…)
selfhosted.note: Enter your server's address including its version prefix: vLLM http://host:8000/v1, LiteLLM http://host:4000/v1, One API / New API http://host:3000/v1. The key is optional (the gateway's own token for One API / New API).

claude_cli.name: Claude (subscription)
claude_cli.note: Uses your own Claude login through the Claude Code CLI on this computer.
